title: Module 1: Introduction & Getting Started
content: A Guide for Modern Data-Intensive Applications
speakerNotes: Welcome everyone! Today we start our journey with AMPS. We'll cover what it is, why it's different, and how to get it running.

title: What is AMPS?
content: • **Nontraditional Approach**: Built for streaming data and parallelized multicore systems.
• **Versatility**: Cuts across traditional boundaries of databases, messaging, and analytics.
• **Focus**: Performance, low latency, and ease of use. ⚡
• **Engineered for scale**: Handles the most demanding workloads on the planet.
speakerNotes: AMPS stands for Advanced Message Processing System. It's not just a message bus; it's a platform that combines messaging, storage, and real-time analytics.

title: Common Use Cases
speakerNotes: You'll find AMPS in top-tier financial institutions and tech companies where every microsecond counts.

title: AMPS Core Components
mermaid:
graph TD
    A[AMPS Engine] --> B[Messaging Hub]
    A --> C[SOW Database]
    A --> D[Aggregation Engine]
    B --> B1[Pub/Sub]
    B --> B2[Queuing]
    C --> C1[Current Value Cache]
    D --> D1[Real-time Analytics]
speakerNotes: AMPS integrates messaging, state (SOW), and analytics (CEP) into a single, highly optimized engine.

title: Feature Highlights: Pub/Sub & Filtering
content: • **Topic-Based Pub/Sub**: Support for literal names and Regular Expressions.
• **Content Filtering**: Subscribe to a topic with a `WHERE` clause.
• **Decoupling**: Publishers don't need to know what subscribers want.
speakerNotes: Content filtering is a 'killer feature' of AMPS. It uses SQL-92 and XPath to let subscribers pick exactly what they need.

title: The SOW (State of the World)
content: • **Integrated Database**: Persists the most recent update for each unique record.
• **Atomic Query & Subscribe**: Get initial state AND live updates in one step.
• **Delta Updates**: Send/Receive only the fields that changed. 📉
speakerNotes: SOW is like a database table that's always live. It's built for speed and scales with your hardware.

title: The Transaction Log
content: • **Record & Replay**: A journal of all incoming messages. 📖
• **Full Fidelity**: Replay exactly what happened, in the same order.
• **Durable Subscriptions**: Resume after failure without missing a beat.
speakerNotes: The Transaction Log is the source of truth. It enables replication, message queues, and historical analysis.

title: Installation: Easy as Unzip
content: • **No Dependencies**: Everything needed is in the package.
speakerNotes: Installation is simple. Just unpack it. No complex package management required for the server itself.

speakerNotes: Knowing where things are is the first step. The 'bin' folder is where the action happens.

title: Module 1 Summary
content: • AMPS is a high-performance messaging and storage platform. 🚀
• Features include Pub/Sub, SOW, Queues, and Replay. 🌎
• Runs on Linux with zero external dependencies. 🐧
• Configuration via XML; Messaging often via JSON. 📄
